Hi T.J.,

You're right to chase this, and I'm sorry. You first wrote in on (address hidden), Hal's last note went out on October 29, and you've had nothing since. That gap is on us, not on you.

Where it stands: Hal's findings are settled and he's handed the Rev 6.1 over as a defective unit. The core regulator is latching an undervoltage fault with the input clean at 12.06 V and the output at 0.00 V, and that held across two Meanwell supplies, a full Harlo OS factory flash and a complete esptool erase back to NerdQaxe OS. Nothing about that is firmware or your power supply. The only step left before I can send you a prepaid return label and set up the replacement is the sign-off from our hardware team, and I've pushed it back in front of them with the logs and photos attached.

They're offline over the weekend and pick this up Monday at 10am Eastern. As soon as it's approved, the return label and the return reference come straight to you in this thread, and nothing further is needed from you in the meantime. You don't need to send anything back or buy any postage yourself.

Thanks for the patience and for all the testing you did, it made the diagnosis clean.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi T.J.,

No, you haven't, and I'm sorry. Hal confirmed the fault on October 22 and you have been waiting on us since, through three emails now. That is not how this should have gone.

The diagnosis is not in question. The core regulator latches an undervoltage fault with the input clean at 12.06 V and the output at 0.00 V, and that stayed true across two Meanwell supplies, a Harlo OS factory flash and a full esptool erase back to NerdQaxe OS. It is a board fault, so the unit comes back to us and you get a working one.

The return itself is prepared and ready to go out to you: the reference is Shop····, it goes back to our Chattanooga warehouse, and the postage is on us. The one thing I cannot do myself is the sign-off on the return, and that sits with our hardware team. I have put it in front of them again, marked for today, and they are at their desks from 10am Eastern this morning.

As soon as it clears you get the prepaid label and the return reference in this thread, and nothing is needed from you before then. Please don't buy any postage yourself.

Thanks for your patience with this one.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
